fullDescription: A neo-brutalist mobile food-delivery checkout/basket screen: thick ink outlines and hard offset shadows, line-item cards with quantity steppers, a promo-code row, an itemized order summary, and a bold purple "Proceed to pay" CTA.

structured.summary: A neo-brutalist mobile food-delivery checkout (basket) screen: a delivery-address banner, line-item cards with quantity steppers, an 'Add promo code' row, an itemized order summary (item total / discount / tax / total), and a bold primary 'Proceed to pay' button. Thick ink outlines + hard offset shadows give it a confident, distinctive look.

style.description: Neo-brutalism: thick ink borders, hard offset (non-blurred) shadows, a warm cream ground, soft pastel category tints, one purple CTA, a serif display headline.
style.prompt: Neo-brutalist system: 2px ink borders (#1c1714) + HARD offset shadows (solid, non-blurred) applied uniformly to every card/control. Warm cream grounds (#fffdfb / #fff6f1 / #ece6df), soft pastel tints per block (peach #feebe4/#fcd9c8, blue #eef6fd/#d9ecfb). ONE accent: purple #a091fb on the primary CTA + small active states. Two-face type pairing: Fraunces (serif display, for the 'Your basket' headline) + Plus Jakarta Sans (UI/body). Generous rounded corners despite the brutalist borders. Light, warm, confident.

layout_and_structure.description: Single mobile checkout screen: status bar, top nav (back + cart count), serif title, delivery-address banner, line-item cards, promo row, order summary, sticky pay CTA.

prompts.prompt: Status bar; a row with an outlined circular back button (left), a serif 'Your basket' title (center, with a small 'FRESHLY' eyebrow above), and an outlined cart button with a count badge (right).
A peach-tinted bordered banner: a pin icon, 'DELIVER TO' label + address, and a chevron to change it; below it two small outlined pills (e.g. '25 min', 'Free delivery').
Bordered item cards, each with a tinted thumbnail, dish name + a short descriptor, price (right), and a quantity stepper (-, count, +) in an outlined pill.
A full-width bordered 'Add promo code' row with a tag icon and a trailing action button.
A bordered summary card: item total, discount (with a small 'saved $X' tag), tax & fees, then a bold Total in the serif/strong weight.
A bold full-width purple 'Proceed to pay ->' button with the neo-brutalist border + hard offset shadow, anchored at the bottom.

special_ui_components.prompt: A rounded card with a 2px ink border and a solid (non-blurred) offset shadow, e.g. 4px 4px 0 #1c1714, on a tinted or cream fill.
An outlined pill with a minus button, the current count, and a plus button; ink borders, no blur.

structured.special_notes: Apply the border + hard-offset-shadow system uniformly (consistency is what sells neo-brutalism). Keep purple to the CTA. Real mobile proportions (~390px-wide phone).
